records.title: Dependency-Aware Semi-Structured Sparsity: Declining Roles of Outliers in Pruning GLU-based LLMs
records.reason: DaSS prunes GLU-based LLMs (LLaMA2/Mistral/Gemma) with a dependency-aware semi-structured metric combining weight magnitude and MLP intermediate activation norms, explicitly targeting serving memory size and token-generation latency with hardware-friendly N:M sparsity patterns outperforming SparseGPT and Wanda.

records.title: Adaptive Inverse Transform Sampling For Efficient Vision Transformers
records.reason: Adaptive Token Sampling inserts a parameter-free module into vision transformers that scores tokens by class-token attention and samples a per-image token count, halving GFLOPs on ImageNet/video classification; it is token-reduction for ViT inference efficiency, but the target is vision classification rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Arabic Compact Language Modelling for Resource Limited Devices
records.reason: Trains a compact Arabic BERT-style language model for resource-limited devices and applies distillation and quantization to shrink it further (largest model 2x smaller than baseline with better task scores); on-device motivation is real, but the contribution is language-model training for Arabic NLP, not an inference system or measured serving technique.

records.title: RECAP: Training-Free Compensation for Coarse Activation Channel Pruning in Compressed LLMs
records.reason: RECAP compensates training-free for coarse activation-channel pruning in compressed LLMs: it estimates the activation error from removing a channel and transfers it into the corresponding weights with grouped outlier-robust statistics, restoring LLaMA3-8B BoolQ accuracy from 38.75% to 72.48% at 70% activation-channel sparsity while keeping hardware-friendly channel sparsity.

records.title: TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architecture Search
records.reason: TF-MAS is a training-free neural architecture search for Mamba2 that scores candidate SSD-block architectures with a rank-collapse proxy over transformation matrices; it searches model architectures for accuracy, with no inference system, serving, or deployment measurement.

records.title: LLM-Guided Autoscheduling for Large-Scale Sparse Machine Learning
records.reason: Autosparse uses an LLM to propose fusion groupings and legal dataflow orders inside a sparse-ML compiler for GCN/GraphSAGE workloads; the LLM is a search tool for sparse tensor scheduling, and there is no contribution to LLM inference, serving, or decoding.

records.title: A Black-Box Graph Partitioner for Generalized Deep Neural Network Parallelization
records.reason: BBGraP is a model- and device-agnostic black-box graph partitioner that generates data-parallel execution plans for deep-learning inference across heterogeneous nodes, removing redundant transfers and synchronization for a 30% latency reduction on three nodes; it is distributed inference partitioning, but demonstrated only as a proof of concept on generic DNNs, not LLMs.

records.title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention
records.reason: Minimal Test-Time Intervention detects high-entropy tokens during reasoning and applies selective classifier-free guidance only there, reusing the main model's KV cache to approximate the unconditional branch cheaply; it is a decoding-time algorithm, but its measured contribution is reasoning accuracy (+9.28% average) rather than inference-system performance.

records.title: 2.5-dimensional Distributed Model Training
records.reason: SUMMA2.5-LM proposes 2.5-dimensional tensor parallelism that cuts per-layer transmission cost for distributed language-model training (1.45x weak-scaling efficiency over 2D); the work is entirely about training parallelization, not inference or serving.

records.title: RGP: Achieving Memory-Efficient Model Fine-tuning Via Randomized Gradient Projection
records.reason: RGP projects gradients with random matrices to cut optimizer-state memory during LLM fine-tuning, beating GaLore on GLUE while training 74% faster; it optimizes the training/fine-tuning loop and makes no inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Mixture of Virtual Prompts: Efficient Fine-tuning with Virtual Prompts for Natural Language Understanding
records.reason: Mixture of Virtual Prompts learns sets of virtual prompts of distinct capacities and dynamically aggregates them to adapt frozen pre-trained models to NLU tasks with 0.03% of parameters; this is parameter-efficient fine-tuning for task adaptation, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Efficient and performant Transformer private inference with heterogeneous attention mechanisms
records.reason: EPTI-style private Transformer inference under secure two-party secret sharing replaces expensive Softmax/GELU evaluations with specialized operator approximations (Multiplicative Residual Softmax), cutting communication volume 10.2-25.4% and end-to-end latency up to 41.7% on WAN emulation; it targets private-inference efficiency for generic Transformers rather than LLM serving specifically.

records.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
records.reason: PlanFence is a dependency-scoped validation protocol for distributed LLM-agent shared memory: plans cite their input records and executors validate only action-relevant dependencies before acting, eliminating stale-plan execution in 30 five-agent workflows; it concerns agent coordination correctness, not model inference systems.

records.title: Scalable Binary-Quantized Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Vision
records.reason: Proposes a Tower architecture and unified training scheme for vision networks with integer weights/activations down to binary, plus a refined resource-usage estimation methodology; binary quantization is inference-relevant, but the contribution is training vision models and no LLM or serving evaluation is provided.

records.title: Meta-Learning at Scale for Large Language Models via Low-Rank Amortized Bayesian Meta-Learning
records.reason: ABMLL amortizes Bayesian meta-learning into LoRA variables so LLMs can be adapted to multiple datasets for few-shot generalization (CrossFit/Unified-QA); it is a fine-tuning/meta-learning method for training-time adaptation, with no inference-system or serving contribution.

records.title: DiffuGR: Generative Document Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: DiffuGR reframes generative document retrieval as discrete diffusion over DocIDs, generating tokens in parallel with a controllable number of denoising steps that explicitly trades retrieval quality against latency at inference; the decoding mechanism is inference-relevant, but the contribution is a retrieval application, not LLM serving.

records.title: Key Factor Selection Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: Key Factor Selection Transformer forecasts multivariate time series (transportation, meteorology, finance) with a two-stage variable-selection network, Prob-sparse self-attention and a GRU; it is a forecasting application model with no LLM inference or serving content.

records.title: Unseen Horizons: Unveiling the Real Capability of LLM Code Generation Beyond the Familiar
records.reason: OBFusEval benchmarks LLM code-generation capability using three-level code obfuscation over 1,354 cases from five real projects to avoid training-data familiarity; it evaluates model capability and does not touch inference systems, decoding, or serving.

records.title: PlanEval: Augmenting Large Language Models With a Small-Scale Planner-Evaluator for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
records.reason: PlanEval offloads planning and retrieval evaluation to a small-scale planner-evaluator model so the LLM is invoked less for knowledge-intensive multi-step tasks, motivated by the cost and edge-deployment latency of LLM-heavy prompting; the contribution is a task-level agent framework, not an inference-system mechanism.

records.title: LF Transformer: A novel lightweight network for machine translation
records.reason: LF Transformer is a lightweight dual-branch funnel-structured network designed for machine translation that reduces parameter count and the computational load of training and inference; it is a task-specific NMT architecture rather than a general LLM inference or serving technique.
